page.content:
Blood-brother of Odin, trickster, and father of the world's ending.

How Loki connects

  • Character: Fenrir — Loki is father of Fenrir.
  • Character: Jormungandr — Loki is father of Jormungandr.
  • Character: Hel — Loki is father of Hel.
  • Event: Death of Baldur — Loki guided the mistletoe that killed Baldur.
  • Character: Odin — Loki is Odin's blood-brother and the Aesir's most dangerous guest.

What is Loki?

Loki moves among the Aesir as helper and traitor. He sires Fenrir, Jormungandr, and Hel; he engineers Baldur's death; he is bound until Ragnarok, when he breaks free.

Key threads lead to Fenrir, Jormungandr, Hel, Death of Baldur and Odin.
